articles.title: Resolving GlobalProtect error GP-4012 (expired client certificate)
articles.content: Error GP-4012 means the VPN client certificate has expired. Open the VPN portal, confirm the expiry date, and re-issue the certificate profile for the user. Ask the user to restart GlobalProtect and reconnect.

articles.title: Handling mailbox quota exceeded in Exchange Online
articles.content: When a mailbox reaches its quota, enable the online archive and apply the default retention policy. Sending resumes once the primary mailbox is below quota.
